title: NSA Glomar response cites Executive Order 13526

tellings.quote: their exact response, "This agency has determined that the fact of the existence or non-existence [music] of the material you request is a currently improperly classified matter

plain: In 2023 the NSA answered a records request credited to a man named Noah Hradek with a "Glomar" response, a reply that will neither confirm nor deny that the records exist, citing Executive Order 13526, the presidential order on classified information. Michels reads out what he calls their exact words: "This agency has determined that the fact of the existence or non-existence of the material you request is a currently improperly classified matter." He brings it up as a sign the agency is guarding something it will not even admit to holding.
